node.title: Re: Matching nested parens
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I would suggest [mod://Regexp::Common]:

use warnings; use strict; use Data::Dump; use Regexp::Common qw/balanced/; "(a a (a a)(a a))(b b(b)b b)" =~ /$RE{balanced}{-parens=>'()'}/; dd $&, $'; # ("(a a (a a)(a a))", "(b b(b)b b)")

Though of course there are plenty of other solutions, including [mod://Parse::RecDescent], though that might be a little overkill if this is all you're doing. See e.g. [id://11112811], and note that [doc://Text::Balanced] is a core module.
